say:0:1221514001:0.text: In his final moments, he called out to the god of the waves...
say:0:1221514001:0.source_cn: 他最后，念着风浪与漂泊之神的名字……

say:1:1221514002:0.text: Let's release him here. The waves will carry him to the god.
say:1:1221514002:0.source_cn: 就在这里将他送入大海吧，海浪会带他去神的身边。
say:1:1221514002:0.male: Let's release him here. The waves will carry him to the god.
say:1:1221514002:0.female: Let's release him here. The waves will carry him to the god.
